reason: The RCP effects bullet states every part with the same scope: principals accessing resources in a member account with an applicable RCP, regardless of organization membership, including root users, except service-linked roles. The page Note states the RCP-for-external and SCP-for-own-principals split; the IAM user guide summary of RCPs in the corpus agrees, so the claim is current.

The Principal element page states verbatim that the IAM resource-based policy type is a role trust policy and that its Principal element specifies who can assume the role; the IAM roles page states the principals you can specify include users, roles, accounts, and services. The claim says include, so the access_policies list (with federated users) does not conflict.
